editorial:
Imagine going back to your high school reunion only to find out someone is killing off your old friends one by one. That is exactly what happens to Laney in this wild ride. She is already nervous about seeing people from her past because of some old drama, but things go from awkward to deadly very quickly. You get to see her struggle to protect her daughter while trying to figure out which of her former classmates has turned into a cold-blooded killer. The vibe is like a throwback mystery with a modern twist, keeping you on edge as the body count rises.

What really works here is the pacing, as the story moves quickly and keeps you guessing. The acting feels real, and the tension builds up nicely until the big reveal. While some of the plot twists are a bit predictable, it is still a total blast to watch. It is the perfect choice for a movie night with friends.
endingExplained: The big twist reveals that the killer was actually the most liked person from their class who held a secret grudge for years. In the final scenes, the killer tries to trap Laney and her daughter in the gym. After a tense fight, Laney manages to outsmart the killer and save her daughter just in time. The police arrive to wrap everything up, and Laney finally finds peace with her past.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves whodunnit mysteries and high school drama.
